professionalService.problemSolved: Helps an architect explain what rooms and vertical movement lie behind one hillside section drawing while keeping the cut readable as perspective, material and light are introduced.
professionalService.serviceOutcome: One technical 1:100 section opens its lens without losing the cut, gains material and sunlight, visits stair/rooms/pool and returns to a material section before editorial service copy.
professionalService.decisionValue: Supports discussion of level relationships, circulation, daylight and the link between a technical cut and occupied space. The specific house, site and project facts are authored donor content.

evidence.statement: README states the cut-size lens opening, ink/material scan and room-by-room visit.
The complete desktop forward video shows the cut, tour, material return and editorial ending.
